put.description: Store a hand-edited circuit as a new version (saved even if it has ERC errors).

post.description:
Simulate a version, optionally overriding the transient stop time and step.

Overrides apply to this run only; the stored circuit is unchanged.

get.description: The ngspice deck for a version, for use in other simulators or for debugging.

200.description: Server-Sent Events; each `data:` line is a StreamEvent.

EndpointIn.title: EndpointIn
EndpointIn.description:
Create or update a model endpoint.

On update, ``api_key`` of ``None`` keeps the stored key and ``""`` clears it.

Expectation.title: Expectation
Expectation.description:
What the circuit must do, verified on the simulation, e.g. ``I(D1) > 5m``
``when`` ``light(LDR1) < 1``. See :mod:`.expectations` for the grammar.

ExpectationResult.title: ExpectationResult
ExpectationResult.description: Whether one of the circuit's expectations held in the simulation.

OutputMode.title: OutputMode
OutputMode.description:
How strictly the provider is asked to emit JSON.

``auto`` picks the strongest mode the provider is known to support and
degrades gracefully (schema -> JSON mode -> plain text) when it is rejected.

Probe.title: Probe
Probe.description: A signal to plot: a net voltage (relative to GND) or the current through a component.

PwlWave.title: PwlWave
PwlWave.description:
Piecewise-linear waveform: straight lines through ``(time, value)`` points.

Holds the last value after the final point. Good for ramps and slow profiles such
as a solar panel going from day to night.

SimulateOptions.title: SimulateOptions
SimulateOptions.description: Run-bar overrides for a transient simulation; omitted fields keep the circuit's own.

EndpointFailed.description: The endpoint errored or exhausted its attempts; the next endpoint is tried.
EndpointFailed.title: EndpointFailed

Planned.description: The design was planned: the component families to use and a short sketch.
Planned.title: Planned

TurnSaved.description: Final stream event: what was persisted for this turn.
TurnSaved.title: TurnSaved

ValidationFailed.description: The model answered but its circuit failed parsing or ERC; a repair turn follows.
ValidationFailed.title: ValidationFailed
